'''Outer Region Foxar Scout Base''' was a headquarters affiliated to the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]].

During the times of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[NRSS Founder|NRSS ''Founder'']] left Outer Region Foxar Scout Base with a crew of three [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Deeve]], [[Jarsa]] and [[Effcee]], to survey eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in different [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], searching valuable natural resources. The ''Founder'' was to return to Outer Region Foxar Scout Base once the mission was over.
